_mandatory_statement: On NO-GO, the F5 product is returned to its unmodified baseline state. No 3D code, dependency, asset, control, test, or claim may remain in the repository after the deletion is machine-verified.
_note: This artifact defines the NO-GO branch for F6 gate task 6.3.5. decision_status is DEFERRED — this branch executes when ANY of the 7 conjunctive GO threshold groups fails, returns INCONCLUSIVE, or remains PENDING at the time the F6 gate outcome is determined. While all thresholds are PENDING_EXECUTION, the deletion plan is fully specified here so that it can be executed without ambiguity. No deletion actions in this file may be executed while decision_status is DEFERRED. Execution is triggered only when any prerequisite_check in go-branch-decision.json fails to record a PASS verdict.

activation_conditions._comment: The NO-GO branch activates on ANY single miss in the 7 conjunctive threshold groups. The conjunctive rule is frozen in preregistration.json task_6_1_4 and cannot be changed post-hoc. INCONCLUSIVE counts as FAIL. PENDING at decision time counts as FAIL.
activation_conditions.rule: ANY single condition from the list below is sufficient to activate NO-GO. All conditions are evaluated conjunctively for GO; thus a single failure triggers NO-GO.

conditions.description: Study outcome does not reach ≥10% median task-time or error improvement, OR Wilcoxon p≥0.05, OR fewer than 20 valid paired trials, OR any primary measure shows statistically significant degradation, OR study/analysis/results.json go_no_go_determination.verdict ≠ STUDY_GO.
WebKitGTK real-scene p95 frame time > 33.3 ms (< 30 FPS) under idle or contention conditions on RHW-001, OR fewer than 30 warm frame samples collected, OR evidence artifact absent.
rAF does not stop within 2000 ms after last input, OR idle CPU delta > 2 percentage points above F5 baseline, OR evidence artifact absent.
3D peak heap > 1.5× 2D/list baseline, OR any individual GC pause ≥ 50 ms, OR VRAM delta > 256 MB above idle on RHW-001, OR any measurement artifact absent.

ANY of the 4 a11y sub-checks fails: (1) WebGL context loss does not fall back to 2D/list with same query/focus/pending state in ≤2 s; (2) keyboard navigation fails any of 5 steps in 3D condition; (3) Orca does not announce entity names and Inspector confirmation in 3D; (4) new serious/critical axe-core findings vs 2D/list baseline.
conditions.triggers_no_go_when: ANY sub-check status ∈ {FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, PENDING_EXECUTION, missing}

conditions.description: F5 E2E suite does not pass against 3D-enabled build with zero regressions across all seven destinations, OR any test that passed in F5 2D/list baseline fails in the 3D-enabled build, OR evidence artifact absent.

Any new dependency introduced by the 3D spike has an unresolved, pending, rejected, or incompatible FOSS disposition; OR any dependency's checksum cannot be reproduced; OR any upstream repository is unmaintained/archived/CVE-affected; OR SBOM diff artifact absent.

Any supply-chain or maintenance failure per DR-3: a new npm or Rust dependency that has an unresolved/pending/rejected FOSS disposition, an unmaintained/archived upstream, a known CVE, a non-reproducible checksum, or a security advisory forcing a breaking API change.

Any semantic divergence (DR-4): 3D renderer maintains its own truth, policy, layout state, or node/edge authority not derived purely from SemanticScene/pathScene.ts; renderer introduces its own record fetching or graph traversal outside GraphQueryPort; renderer writes back to SQLite authority; or renderer's visible node/edge set diverges from 2D canvas.

Any degradation of an existing F5 baseline metric attributable to 3D renderer presence (DR-5): task time, error count, E2E pass rate, VRAM, frame time, idle CPU, or any metric covered by the F5 evidence manifest.

deletion_steps._comment: Ordered sequence of deletion actions. All steps must be executed in the listed order. Each step references the source inventory in task_6_2_7 or task_6_1_5 of preregistration.json. No step may be skipped. Deletion is mandatory and not discretionary.
deletion_steps._execution_gate: decision_status must change from DEFERRED to NO-GO (set only when any activation_condition is confirmed triggered) before any step below is executed.

steps.description: Delete all 11 new source files from task_6_2_7.f6_spike_source_files. These are files that did not exist before the F6 spike and are exclusively consumed by the memory-graph 3D renderer.

Revert all 4 pre-existing files modified during the F6 spike to their F5 state. The F5 state is the last committed version of each file before any F6 spike modifications. Use git checkout <F5_RELEASE_COMMIT> -- <file> where F5_RELEASE_COMMIT is recorded in the F5 evidence manifest.

files.revert_to: F5 committed state — pre-spike version that is dormant/contains no spike wiring
F5 committed state — does not accept packed transferable buffers from spike
F5 committed state — does not integrate with z-mapping pipeline
F5 committed state — does not register spike renderer or conditional 3D/2D path

steps.description: Remove any F6-specific npm packages from ui/package.json. The F5 baseline retains three@0.169.0, @types/three@0.169.0, ngraph.forcelayout@3.3.1, and ngraph.graph@20.0.1 only if they were present before the spike and are still consumed by ConstellationCanvas3D. Any new package introduced exclusively by the F6 spike (identified via the SBOM diff in evidence/F6/run-001/supply-chain/sbom-diff.json) must be removed. Also revert any version bumps of existing packages where the bump was introduced by the spike and ConstellationCanvas3D does not require the bumped version.
steps.note: If the spike introduced no new npm packages and no version bumps, this step is a no-op. The SBOM diff is the authoritative source of truth.

steps.description: Remove any F6-specific Rust crates from Cargo.toml. No F6-specific Rust crates are expected (the spike is a UI/TypeScript concern), but if the SBOM diff records any Rust crate added exclusively for the F6 renderer, it must be removed from Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock.
steps.note: If the spike introduced no new Rust crates (expected case), this step is a no-op. The SBOM diff is the authoritative source of truth.

steps.description: Delete or revert any documentation or marketing claims introduced by the F6 spike: README.md sections advertising 3D memory-graph path exploration, CHANGELOG entries listing 3D as shipped or experimental, in-app UI copy implying 3D capability, and any .kiro/specs/ doc files created exclusively for the F6 implementation (distinct from this preregistration and the no-go-branch-decision.json).

Any CHANGELOG entry added during F6 spike that lists 3D path exploration as a shipped or experimental feature
Any in-app UI copy (tooltip, help, onboarding) implying the Knowledge destination has 3D capability
Any conditional branch in Knowledge.tsx (or equivalent) that mounts a 3D path view
Any F6-specific feature flag/constant/environment variable: VITE_ENABLE_F6_3D, F6_3D_ENABLED, enable3DPathView, CAPABILITY_3D_PATH_RENDERER, or equivalent
Any F6-specific Tauri capability/permission entry in tauri.conf.json, capabilities/*.json, or permissions/*.toml
Any F6-specific Rust feature flag in Cargo.toml

steps.verification: The regenerated package-lock.json must not contain any package identified as F6-exclusive in the SBOM diff.

steps.verification: The regenerated Cargo.lock must not contain any crate identified as F6-exclusive in the SBOM diff.

mvi_checks_reference.verification_rule: All 20 MVI checks must pass before the deletion step is considered complete. Any failing check is an inventory miss and blocks recording the NO-GO outcome in the F6 evidence manifest. The delta checks (MVI-D-01 through MVI-D-07) run in step 9 of deletion_steps. The original checks (MVI-1 through MVI-13) run as a final sweep after all deletion steps complete.

post_deletion_verification._comment: Summary of what must be verified after all deletion steps are complete and before the NO-GO outcome is recorded in the F6 evidence manifest.

required_checks.name: All 20 MVI checks pass
required_checks.description: Run all 13 original MVI checks (from task_6_1_5) and all 7 delta MVI checks (from task_6_2_7). Every check must return the expected result. Zero failures permitted.

required_checks.name: TypeScript build passes
required_checks.description: cd ui && npm run typecheck exits with code 0 and zero errors. The post-deletion UI codebase must compile without any reference to deleted spike files or reverted module exports.

required_checks.description: The full F5 E2E test suite (CMD-GUI-E2E) must pass against the post-deletion build with zero regressions. The deletion must not have introduced any regression in the 7-destination F5 product. All workflows (find, inspect, explain, correct, merge, split, relate, path, goal, source, forget, restore, delete, offline, recovery) must pass.
required_checks.expected_result: Zero test failures. Suite is identical to the F5 baseline suite — no tests added or removed to compensate for deletion.

required_checks.description: The post-deletion SBOM (regenerated in step 8) must match the F5 SBOM baseline with no new entries. No F6-exclusive npm package or Rust crate may appear in the dependency closure.

required_checks.name: No spike artifacts in git working tree
required_checks.description: git status --short must show no untracked spike files and no uncommitted modifications to the 4 reverted files. The working tree must be clean with respect to all F6 spike changes.

post_deletion_verification.summary: After NO-GO deletion: (1) all 20 MVI checks pass confirming no spike code, dependency, flag, or claim remains; (2) the TypeScript build passes cleanly; (3) the F5 E2E suite passes with zero regressions; (4) the SBOM matches the F5 baseline with no new entries; (5) the git working tree is clean. Only when all 5 verification groups are satisfied may the NO-GO outcome be recorded in the F6 evidence manifest and the F5→F6 manifest chain be annotated with a closed NO-GO outcome.

no_go_outcome_recording.description: After all deletion steps are executed and all post-deletion verification checks pass, the NO-GO outcome is recorded by updating the F6 evidence manifest (evidence/F6/run-001/manifest.json) with the NO-GO decision, the list of threshold verdicts that triggered NO-GO, the deletion completion timestamp, and hashes of the 6 retained evidence files. The F5 manifest predecessor hash is then annotated with a closed F6 NO-GO outcome.
